prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Californium (Cf) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a rooftop drying terrace with laundry lines overhead, a low stool, a parapet and the city beyond
Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on; a deep blue sky, the first lights coming on around her.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a bikini fastened with polished metal buckles at the centre front and the hips — in bright cobalt blue; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a glossy wet-look swim fabric and a silk ribbon tied in her hair, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly below, looking up at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand makes a V sign beside her face.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — californium: a silvery synthetic metal first made in 1950 by striking curium with alpha particles, and named for the golden western land and university where she was born, a land itself named after a legendary island of gold at the western edge of the world, ruled by a queen of warrior women armed in gold; one of her forms splits apart on its own, so a single microgram pours out over two million neutrons every second, an invisible spray used to kindle new nuclear reactors, to find hidden veins of gold and silver and pockets of oil deep underground, to spot concealed explosives and to fight cancer, and a single gram of her is worth tens of millions — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
